title: Signature-driven deployment sentinel with automatic rewind for cohort rollouts
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: We still see noisy or subtle degradations during config and model flips that slip past coarse metric thresholds. Current canary/A-B gates look only at aggregate eval scores and token-level SLOs, which miss distributional shifts in output quality for critical cohorts.

Proposal: Implement a 'signature-driven sentinel' that computes compact output-quality signatures per request cohort (embedding of model output + scalar quality signals) and continuously compares live signature distributions to baseline canary/control using robust distributional distances and change-point detection. The sentinel will integrate with the rollout controller to automatically throttle, isolate cohorts, and 'auto-rewind' a change when confidence in regression exceeds configurable thresholds. This complements existing aggregate eval gates and provides faster detection of cohort-specific regressions during progressive rollouts and A/B experiments.
acceptance_criteria: Sentinel emits per-cohort divergence score every minute and persists snapshots to the console for provenance
Automatic rewind triggers when divergence > 0.18 (Wasserstein) sustained for >= 10 minutes on >= 2 cohorts, with audit log entry linking to triggering eval run
False positive rate < 2% in synthetic backtests across 12 historical deployment events
Integration tests that simulate model config regressions cause the rollout controller to follow the documented auto-rewind sequence
Dashboard tile in Console showing signature drift, top contributing features, and linked PR/commit that caused change
tasks: Design: signature schema (embedding dims, quality scalars) and storage format (compact snapshots)
Implement streaming signature extractor in the runtime inference path with minimal p99 impact
Server-side detector: implement Wasserstein + KS hybrid comparator and Bayesian online changepoint detector
Integrate detector with rollout controller (canary/A-B) to support throttle/rewind decisions and manual override
E2E tests: synthetic regressions, cohort-level injections, and backfill replay harness
Console: add signature visualization, alerts, and audit trail links
PRD & runbook: document thresholds, hysteresis settings, and operational playbook

implementation_notes: Signature format: 64-d float32 embedding from a lightweight transformer projection + three scalars (mean token logprob, repetition_penalty_score, semantic_coherence_score). Distance metrics: primary = sliced-Wasserstein on embeddings (fast approximate), secondary = KS test on scalar distributions. Change detection uses Bayesian online change point detection with a minimum effect size filter to avoid chasing noise. Hysteresis: 'escalation_window' = 10m, 'reversion_cooldown' = 30m. When auto-rewind triggers, we capture: rollout snapshot, cohort IDs, top n contributing examples, and evaluation artifacts to S3 with provenance tags (commit, model_version, config_hash).
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Offline: run the sentinel in passive mode across last 90 days of traffic and produce backtest report. Phase 1: Canary (1% traffic, 3 cohorts) with alerting enabled but no auto-rewind for 48h. Phase 2: Canary + auto-rewind enabled with conservative thresholds on non-prod and select customers. Phase 3: Expand to 10% and support A/B experiments with cohort-level isolation. At every phase, we create an audit entry that ties triggering evidence to the config/model change (commit hash).
rollback_policy_summary: Automatic rewind sequence: 1) mark rollout as 'paused' and reduce new exposure by 80% within 30s, 2) shift remaining traffic back to last stable variant, 3) run automated regression eval on flight samples and generate report, 4) open incident with pre-filled template in PagerDuty + include signature snapshots, 5) retain logs/snapshots for 90 days. Manual override: SRE/PM can force an immediate rollback or resume after review. Hysteresis prevents back-to-back flips; repeated auto-rewinds escalate to manual gate. The policy is configurable per-customer for Dedicated/Private deployments.
test_plan: Unit tests for extractor and comparator, integration tests for detector <-> rollout controller hooks, replay tests using a corpus of labeled regressions (historic incidents), synthetic injection tests that perturb embeddings/scalars to simulate subtle regressions, and chaos tests that flip network/storage latency to validate robustness. Define an acceptance test that runs against a nightly canary cluster and verifies no false positive for baseline traffic for 7 days.
